power_unit: kVA (apparent power -- no power factor available, NOT true kW)
power_source: Stabilizer R/Y/B Voltage x Current -- the only sensor group with both voltage and current in this dataset
baseline_method: mean/std of apparent power conditioned on operating_state only
limitation: No RPM, spindle load, or cutting-state signal exists in the raw sensor set. Secondary candidate predictors (axis servo temps, spindle motor temp) were tested and only weakly correlate with power within ACTIVE state (r=0.17-0.19) -- too weak to build a defensible finer-grained baseline. This baseline will under-explain legitimate load variation within ACTIVE state; that residual spread (~13% CV) is a real, currently-unmodelable limitation, not noise to be corrected away.
